resourceName: Reforestation of deforested land in Madagascar
description: The project is located in the district of Bekoratsaka, in the northwestern part of MadagascaReforestation of deforested land in Madagascar through the establishment of a training centre for sustainable forestry developmentr. The local population depends on subsistence agriculture and lives in extreme poverty. Lands are in process of degradation, mainly due to uncontrolled wild-fires. The project’s objective is to develop forestry and agricultural activities in order to restore ecosystem functionality and to generate income for the population.  The project is owned by the local cooperative „Avotrala“, whose members are the communities that live around the project area. Avotrala is supported by the Swiss non-profit organisation „EcoFormation“. A center has been built for vocational training and collaborations have been established with Swiss Universities for knowledge exchange.  One project activity that started in 2011 is the reforestation of 6,000 hectares of degraded land that is not further used for agriculture, with fast growing exotic species as well slow growing, high value indiginous species.
